hypothesis: Alcohol and color intensity have a positive Pearson correlation of at least 0.60 after centering within cultivar.

source.citation: Aeberhard, S. & Forina, M. (1992). Wine [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

method: Pearson correlation of alcohol and color intensity after centering each measurement within each cultivar. The baseline is zero association. Permute intensity within cultivar, seed 9015, for 999 draws. Use a one-sided add-one p-value.
negative_control: The first prespecified permutation must have absolute correlation at most 0.25.
limitations: Fixed public observational dataset. No causal or external validity claim. Row independence within cultivar is not established.
